## Import Libraries
```{r import libraries}
library(tidyverse)
library(tidyr)
library(sf) #for mapping
library(mapdata) # preloaded shape files for major world maps
library(ggmagnify)
library(sp)
library(readxl)
library(patchwork)

```

## Site Map
ggmagnify: https://github.com/hughjonesd/ggmagnify/tree/master 
```{r site map}
sttstj <- read_sf("Data/Mapping/CUSPLine.shp")
st_crs(sttstj) # look at coordinate reference system
```


```{r}
site_pts <- read_csv("Data/Mapping/Sitepoints.csv")

mapstt <- ggplot(data = sttstj) +
  geom_sf()+
  coord_sf(xlim = c(-65.1, -64.81), ylim = c(18.29, 18.39), expand = FALSE) +
  theme_bw()+
  geom_point(data = site_pts, aes(x = Long, y = Lat), color = "red") 
  #geom_magnify(shape = "rect")
mapstt

ggsave("Outputs/Figures/stt_BPT_FLC.png", plot = mapstt, dpi = 300)

from_bbbp <- c(xmin = -64.983, xmax = -64.986, ymin = 18.33, ymax = 18.345)
to_bbbp <- c(-64.95, -64.92, 18.34, 18.38)
mapstt + geom_magnify(from = from_bbbp, to = to_bbbp)

ggsave("Outputs/Figures/stt_BPT_mag.png", plot = mapstt, dpi = 300)

from_fc <- c(xmin = -64.993, xmax = -64.989, ymin = 18.316, ymax = 18.32)
to_fc <- c(-65.1, -65.01, 18.298, 18.34)

mapstt + geom_magnify(from = from_fc, to = to_fc, axes = "xy")

ggsave("Outputs/Figures/stt_FLC_mag.png", plot = mapstt, dpi = 300)

```
